Flins.name: Flins
Flins.description: Flins is the main hero, a brave and smart warrior wielding Electro power.
Flins.bio: Flins is an experienced warrior from Snezhnaya, specializing in spear mastery and Electro energy control.
Flins.talent_attack_desc:
Normal Attack:
Performs up to five consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack:
Dashes forward, damaging all enemies in the path.
Flins.talent_skill_desc: Summons ancient Electro power, dealing area damage and applying the 'Illumination' status to enemies.
Flins.talent_burst_desc: Summons a powerful thunderstorm that deals massive Electro damage and increases the character's attack speed.
Flins.c1_desc: Increases the duration of the 'Illumination' effect by 3 seconds.
Flins.c3_desc: Increases the level of 'Ancient Ritual: Secret Light' by 3.
Flins.c4_desc: When Elemental Burst is activated, restores 15 Energy to all party members.
Flins.c5_desc: Increases the level of 'Ancient Ritual: Night Falls' by 3.
Flins.c6_desc: Critical hits with Elemental Burst apply 'Thunderstorm' to enemies, increasing Electro DMG taken by 30%.
